{{Youmay|the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]&ndash;in&ndash;training|[[Clone Cadets|the television episode of the same name]]|linebreak=1}}
[[File:CloneCadets-CC.png|thumb|right|250px|Clone cadets during their final examination in Tipoca City's Military Complex]]
'''Clone cadet''',<ref name="CloneCadets">{{TCW|Clone Cadets}}</ref> also known as '''clone trooper trainee''',<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=#55: Clone Trooper (Training Fatigues)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TAC55clone.asp}}</ref> was the rank held by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that had yet to complete their intensive combat training. These [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]]—all [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], like the rest of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]]—continued their training on the [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], at the [[Clone military education complex|military training facility]] in [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]].<ref name="CloneCadets" />

==History==
By the [[21 BBY/Legends|second year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Star Wars Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> at the [[Galactic Standard Calendar|chronological]] age of six [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]], clone cadets were embarking with their training units on tours of the Republic's [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], where they were given a chance to observe [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] functioning in the field. Overseen by a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone sergeant]], the cadets practiced [[Blaster/Legends|shooting]] targets grouped in [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] formation. A young [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] disguised himself as a clone cadet aboard the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']], during his attempt to [[Death/Legends|assassinate]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], in retaliation for Windu [[Sai cha/Legends|killing]] Fett's father, Jango, on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="Death Trap">{{TCW|Death Trap}}</ref>

Clone cadets who had reached maturity were organized into [[Squad/Legends|squads]], such as [[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino]] and [[Bravo Squad (clone cadets)/Legends|Bravo Squads]], in which they remained until finally graduating from their training and being brought into active duty.<ref name="CloneCadets" />
